info.name: Gantara isolation
info.summary: Applies the Files sharing rule (share with group members only) to DAV principals, DAV sharing and Deck
info.description: With "Restrict users to only share with users in their groups" on, Files sharing only lets two accounts see each other when they share a group outside the exclusion list. This app applies the same rule to CalDAV/CardDAV principals and homes, calendar and address book sharing, calendar delegation, group principals and Deck board sharing, transfer, cloning and import, and makes the provisioning API's user lookup answer the same for invisible and unknown accounts. It does nothing when the setting is off or nobody is signed in. Gantara enables it on the shared instance only (docs/plans.md, "Contacts and calendar on the shared instance").
